name: VolFav Maker
description: eth-volfav's signal (buy the favourite when the market's implied vol is well above a HAR vol forecast, a few minutes before close), executed as a maker: a post-only bid one tick above the favourite's best bid, cancelled after 25 s. Makers pay no fee and don't cross the spread, which is most of what a taker gives away on ETH.
hypothesis: Written before testing: eth-volfav's taker edge (~+2c/contract) is roughly what fee + spread cost (~3-5c), so the same signal executed passively should earn several cents more per contract, IF the fills we get are not adversely selected away. Who's on the other side: the same reversal-buying underdog takers eth-volfav trades against, now selling the favourite into our bid instead of us lifting their offers. Proved wrong if the walk-forward's per-contract result is not above eth-volfav's own (+2.16c) or the CI includes zero, i.e. fills on the signal are adversely selected like dog-seller's back-of-queue fills (-2.1c within 30 s).
next: Rejected before the pipeline: engine ad hoc, maker +0.77c/ct vs taker +1.77c/ct on the identical signal (Jun-Jul), May -0.14c; adverse selection -5.7c in 30 s cancels the saved fee+spread. Optional real-book check: take=0 in a spare paper slot (execution only).
